products.label: A
products.reason: Bonded glass-silicon wafers are a natural extension of the firm’s existing wafer substrate products, but they add a new bonding capability beyond plain glass wafers.

products.label: B
products.reason: Mechanical release carrier wafers are essentially a variant of the wafer handling carriers the firm already offered to the same semiconductor customers.

products.label: C
products.reason: UV exposure optical devices are a different product category that relies more on optical-device expertise than on the firm’s existing wafer and carrier offerings.

products.label: D
products.reason: A wafer adapter carrier is directly in line with the firm’s prior wafer handling carrier products.

products.label: E
products.reason: Custom cap wafer solutions fit the same custom wafer product family as the firm’s existing borosilicate, stock, and through-via wafers.

products.label: F
products.reason: A wafer with a structured silicon layer builds on the firm’s wafer processing capabilities, but adds a more specialized silicon structuring step.
